name: hquintero
description: A Colombian man of 33, 174 cm, a bit chubby with a slightly wider torso, so he looks a bit bigger than average; a little softness at the waist that shows in side views. Olive-brown skin that holds colour. Very heavy black eyebrows, a THICK BLACK MOUSTACHE, clean-shaven chin. Dark brown wavy hair, a little too long over the ears, no grey. He WEARS BOLD GLASSES ON HIS FACE in every view: thick, chunky, rounded-rectangular frames in warm AMBER TORTOISESHELL with clear lenses, the temple arms over his ears. An engineer, not a farmer: clean and neat. OUTFIT (casual, age 33): a plain heather-grey crew-neck T-shirt with short sleeves; dark charcoal slim jeans; soft grey low-cut technical sneakers. BOTH HANDS EMPTY in every view unless the pose itself uses them: nothing held, no props. No watch, no rings, no pen, no scars, no tattoos, no hat. PRONOUNS: the view library's prompts say 'she/her'; this character is a MAN - every view must be drawn as him (see _next_session).
